name: founder-id-checker
description: Nine free Claude skills to check an Indonesian business that is already open: the real numbers in Rupiah, a computed verdict (Sehat, Waspada, Kritis), channels and platform fees, what real customers say, the competitors now, permits and tax gaps, a board vote (grow, fix, pivot, close), a 90-day plan and a labelled what-if panel to pre-test a change. Free, MIT.
